title: I made a mobile snake game in Godot — looking for honest feedback (FireFrost Serpent 1v1Gameplay )
author: ImaginationReal9192
selftext:
Hey everyone

I'm an indie developer working on a mobile game called FireFrost Serpent. It's a fantasy-themed snake game with a 1v1 multiplayer mode.

I used some AI-generated artwork for the visuals, and I understand that AI art isn't everyone's cup of tea. However, I've been developing the actual game in Godot, and I'd love for people to try the gameplay before judging the entire project by its artwork.

The game is still in its early stages, so there's plenty of room for improvement.

I'd really appreciate honest feedback on:

\-How the gameplay feels

\-Whether the 1v1 mode is enjoyable

\-The mobile controls and UI

\-What I should improve first

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.FireFrostSerpent.game

I'm not expecting everyone to like it. I just want to learn from other developers and make the game better.

Thanks to anyone willing to give it a try

comments.author: Antiox123456
comments.body:
It would be much more interesting if both snakes were visible on the board and could interact with each other. Right now, it's just a single-player Snake game where you're competing against an ever-increasing number on the board.

Also, the art style screams AI slop.

And... well... it's just another generic Snake game. There's nothing particularly interesting or original about it. It's not 1998 anymore.

replies.author: ImaginationReal9192
replies.body:
It has 1v1 and i also tried to make it with shared arena but the problem is I'm still learning and it gets laggy and has some delay so i skipped that part for the future

replies.author: Antiox123456
replies.body: This is the kind of game that can be easily one-shotted with Opus 5.5 or Astra, so I don't really understand how you can struggle here.

replies.author: ImaginationReal9192
replies.body: I haven't try that and i don't think I'll use ai to fix this issue since I'm learning and if i give every work to ai than I won't learn a thing

replies.author: ImaginationReal9192
replies.body: Would you like to tell me I mean do you have any suggestions how to fix the issue with the time delay, I use Firebase real time data exchange but even it's fast it's only good for messaging or leaderboard system but it's not good for real time multiplayer

replies.author: Antiox123456
replies.body: Firebase is a very bad solution for your problem. It's fundamentally a database. You don't want to store game states, you want to exchange arbitrary messages. The best fit would be a WebSocket server.

replies.author: ImaginationReal9192
replies.body: Thank you i really appreciate I'll start working on that right away
